purpose: Enumerate Binance Spot USDT historical instrument IDs from retained Tardis exchange-details metadata so inactive/dead symbols are not silently omitted from Cohort-001 identity work.

frozen_semantics.availableTo: provider data-collection coverage stop only; never exact exchange delisting time
frozen_semantics.active: current tradability only; never consumed for historical membership
frozen_semantics.duplicate_or_reused_symbol_id: fail closed pending timestamp-safe external identity resolution
frozen_semantics.filtered_universe: Binance Spot instrument IDs ending in USDT; grouped pseudo-symbols excluded
frozen_semantics.provenance_binding: The manifest source digest must be recomputed from the exact retained provider response bytes before JSON parsing. Parsed/caller-authored metadata paired with an unrelated claimed digest is rejected. Duplicate JSON keys and non-standard numeric constants are also rejected so authenticated bytes cannot acquire parser-dependent semantics.
frozen_semantics.capture_time_boundary: captured_at is retained chronology/audit metadata only. Without a separate trusted non-backdateable capture receipt it grants no historical availability, membership, delisting, label, or control authority.
frozen_semantics.fingerprints: manifest_fingerprint binds exact retained source bytes and the authority-limited capture field; enumeration_semantic_fingerprint is permutation-stable over the authority-limited enumerated records only.

next_required_evidence: Timestamp-safe exchange/provider identity and listing/delisting evidence is required before any enumerated symbol can enter historical cohort membership, a delisting competing-risk label, or a matched non-winner pool. Any use of capture chronology as scientific availability evidence additionally requires a trusted non-backdateable capture receipt.
scientific_reason: Prevent present-day survivor filtering without upgrading best-effort/current provider metadata into historical truth; prevent mutated parsed metadata from being laundered through an unrelated retained-response digest; and prevent parser ambiguity or caller-declared capture time from becoming accidental historical evidence authority.
